entry.description: escape NUL characters in `OutputDebugStringAppender` content. `OutputDebugStringW` takes a null terminated string, so a NUL in logged content ended the record there and silently dropped whatever the layout rendered after it, exception text and trailing fields included (CWE-158). The escape `LocalSyslogAppender` already applied is now shared between the two (audit da18b6fd-f009, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
